caption: The drawing features a single ceramic mug placed centrally on a plain, off-white background. The mug is rendered in shades of brown and tan, giving it a natural, earthy appearance with subtle gradients suggesting the texture and gloss of fired clay. It has a rounded body with a slightly narrower neck and base, and a wide, circular mouth. A sturdy handle is attached to the left side of the mug, curving smoothly from the rim to the body’s middle section. Decorative bands encircle the upper and lower parts of the mug, with the upper band featuring a row of small raised dots. The mug casts a faint shadow beneath it. The artist's signature, "Carl Buergerniss," is written in small letters on the lower right of the drawing.
title: Stoneware Mug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
